name: Paladin (2024)
description: Paladins are united by their oaths to stand against evil, wielding divine magic and martial prowess.
starting_equipment_options: (A) Chain Mail, Shield, Longsword, 6 Javelins, Holy Symbol, Priest’s Pack, and 9 GP
spell_slots_and_prepared_spells_progress: Refer to Paladin Features table in source for Prepared Spells and Spell Slots per Level.

1.name: Lay on Hands
1.description: Pool of healing power = 5x Paladin level. Bonus Action to touch and restore HP from pool. Can expend 5 HP from pool to cure one poison effect instead of healing.

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: Access to Paladin spell list, prepare spells. Start with 2 prepared 1st-level spells. Charisma is spellcasting ability. Can use Holy Symbol as focus.

1.name: Weapon Mastery (Level 1)
1.description: Use mastery properties of 2 kinds of proficient weapons. Change on Long Rest.

2.name: Fighting Style
2.description: Gain a Fighting Style feat or choose Blessed Warrior (learn 2 Cleric cantrips, Cha for spellcasting).

2.name: Paladin_s Smite
2.description: Always have Divine Smite spell prepared. Can cast once without expending a spell slot per Long Rest.

3.name: Channel Divinity (2 uses)
3.description: Use Channel Divinity twice (regain 1 on Short Rest, all on Long). Starts with Divine Sense effect. Subclass adds more options.

3.name: Channel Divinity: Divine Sense
3.description: Bonus Action, for 10 min (or until Incapacitated), know location of Celestials, Fiends, Undead within 60ft, and their type. Detect consecrated/desecrated places/objects.

3.name: Paladin Subclass (Oath)
3.description: Gain a Paladin subclass (Oath). Oath of Devotion detailed in Basic Rules.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.description: Attack twice when taking Attack action.

5.name: Faithful Steed
5.description: Always have Find Steed spell prepared. Can cast once without spell slot per Long Rest.

6.name: Aura of Protection
6.description: Radiate 10ft protective aura (inactive if Incapacitated). You and allies in aura gain bonus to saving throws = Cha mod (min +1). (Aura Expansion at L18 increases range to 30ft).

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat.

9.name: Abjure Foes
9.description: As Magic action, expend Channel Divinity. Target creatures = Cha mod (min 1) within 60ft. Each makes Wis save or Frightened for 1 min (or until damaged). While Frightened, can only move, take an action, OR take a Bonus Action.

10.name: Aura of Courage
10.description: You and allies in Aura of Protection immune to Frightened. If Frightened ally enters, condition suppressed while in aura.

11.name: Radiant Strikes
11.description: When hitting with Melee weapon/Unarmed Strike, target takes extra 1d8 Radiant damage.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat.

14.name: Restoring Touch
14.description: When using Lay on Hands, can expend 5 HP from pool to remove Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned condition instead of healing.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat.

18.name: Aura Expansion
18.description: Aura of Protection range increases to 30 feet.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or other feat. (Boon of Truesight recommended).

source: D&D Beyond Basic Rules 2024 - Paladin Class
